summary: Story accessibility was never enforced, despite being claimed in CI comments and a ledger entry. addon-a11y's `test: "error"` only takes effect when stories run through addon-vitest, which was installed but never added to main.ts addons and had no vitest project — so `storybook build` merely compiled stories and axe never ran. This is precisely the 'addon as decoration' trap the review-ui skill lists, committed by the person who wrote it. Fixed by wiring addon-vitest and splitting the browser suite into two projects: `contract` (computed-style and keyboard assertions) and `stories` (all 11 stories through axe). A second bug surfaced while wiring: main.ts declared an ABSOLUTE stories glob, which addon-vitest re-resolved against configDir into '.storybook/Users/...', matching nothing — the story project reported success while running zero tests. Glob is now relative. Probed failing-first with an unlabelled input, which the gate rejects.

migration.manual: None for consumers. `pnpm test:browser` now runs both projects.
